identity.name: OpenMM 8.2.0 DHFR PME ensemble on one GPU: sequential versus concurrent MPS
identity.adaptation: Brief supplies fixed-work, seeded eight-replica sequential driver. Published public benchmark uses fixed time and has no step-count or seed CLI.

outcome_definition.goal: Finish same eight independent replica trajectories sooner on one GPU while preserving each scientific outcome.

citations.role: Fixed-work ensemble specification and complete sequential driver; CUDA execution unverified.
Executable public PME benchmark and model construction.

citations.title: Maximizing OpenMM Molecular Dynamics Throughput with NVIDIA Multi-Process Service

components.version_reason: Licenses.txt names LGPL without version in its summary; not resolved here.

components.licence: Distributed in OpenMM repository; no separate input-specific licence verified.
components.intended_use_permission: Brief explicitly permits local running and modification; repository distribution supports supplied benchmark use.

components.reason: Brief supplies code for local benchmark use, but no separate redistribution licence.

source_licences_and_intended_use.redistribution_reason: Intake establishes intended local execution only; no blanket redistribution assessment.

evidence.finding: Public Linux x86_64 glibc 2.27+/2.28+ wheels for CPython 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, 3.13; requires numpy.
Public Linux x86_64 CUDA plugin wheel; dependencies include NVIDIA CUDA runtime, nvcc, NVRTC, CUPTI, cuFFT packages.

requirements: One NVIDIA GPU with CUDA 12 compatible driver
Compatible Linux x86_64 Python and glibc
CUDA MPS service available for proposed concurrent method
unknowns: Stock CUDA image identity and installed Python/driver versions not supplied
MPS binary availability and service permissions unverified
CUDA driver execution and peak memory untested
Transitive pip dependency versions not pinned

resources.data_scope: PDB plus two force-field XML source files; excludes installed dependencies.
resources.reason: No published or measured host/device peak memory for sequential or eight-process execution. Package download sizes do not establish working set.

scoring.primary_metric: Ensemble time to completion, seconds; lower is better.
scientific_outputs: Per-replica final potential energy in kJ/mol
Per-replica mean potential energy over 100 samples in kJ/mol
Potential energy every 250 steps, when retained

scientific_acceptance.reason: No independently published energy acceptance criterion or fixed-work baseline energies. Brief predicts bit-identical series; fallback uses unquantified same-seed sequential run-to-run variation.
scientific_acceptance.brief_proposed_rule: Same-seed energy series identical; if not identical, mean-energy difference no greater than sequential same-seed run-to-run variation.
scientific_acceptance.fallback_threshold_reason: No baseline variability, repetition count, statistic, or numeric threshold supplied.

scoring.performance_acceptance_reason: Brief GPU-specific speedup ranges are predictions, not published acceptance criteria. Published fixed-time throughput reference has no tolerance.

repeatability.reason: Brief does not specify full-workload repeat count.
repeatability.limitation: Deterministic forces do not independently establish complete stochastic trajectory equality under MPS. Brief only reports CPU smoke testing, not CUDA reproduction.

search_note: No benchmark search or substitution. Only brief-linked public sources retrieved.
missing_evidence: Absolute sequential throughput for this fixed-work configuration
intake_scope: One bounded source inspection; no builds, installations, simulations, or scale search.
